open_points.subject: Registry endpoint configuration ownership and read timing
open_points.text: State 2 A30 says “`REGISTRY_BASE_URL` is read by the Registry gateway at each call, not at start-up: it is no required start-up variable,” while State 3 says “Environment values are read once, by `runtime_settings`, into `RuntimeSettings`; other modules … never the environment,” and `runtime_settings` owns loading the closed environment table “once at start.” State 0 R0-10 also says environment configuration is validated when the service starts.
open_points.question: Does `registry_gateway` own a direct per-call environment read of `REGISTRY_BASE_URL`, with that variable excluded from startup loading and validation, or must `runtime_settings` own and validate it once and pass the resulting endpoint to the gateway? The texts must also say whether a missing endpoint prevents startup or only makes Registry calls fail.
options: `registry_gateway` reads `REGISTRY_BASE_URL` from the environment on every call; startup succeeds when it is absent
`runtime_settings` reads and validates `REGISTRY_BASE_URL` once at startup and supplies it to `registry_gateway`; absence prevents startup
open_points.default_guess: Apply the newly accepted exception: let `registry_gateway` read `REGISTRY_BASE_URL` on each call, exclude it from required startup settings, and narrow the State 3 configuration rule and R0-10 accordingly.

witness.initial: The process environment has no `REGISTRY_BASE_URL` when the service is launched; after launch, the operator sets or injects a valid value before a later Registry-backed request.
events: The deployment operator starts the portal without `REGISTRY_BASE_URL`.
A client later invokes an operation requiring Registry validation after the endpoint value becomes available.
outcomes: Startup succeeds; an earlier Registry call fails with `transport_error`, while a later call reads the new value and can succeed.

Startup is refused because runtime configuration validation requires the endpoint, so no later request can occur; alternatively, if startup accepted a missing cached value, the later environment change remains invisible.
witness.observer: The deployment operator and the client making the Registry-backed request
